quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #8
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 30

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic on the road is one-way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: When you see an accident, you should:

options.text: Stop only if you are involved or emergency help has not arrived.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Do not stop at an accident unless you are involved or emergency help has not arrived. Stay focused on driving and keep moving. Watch for people on or near the road. Never stop just to look at an accident, fire, or disaster.

questions.question: When can you carefully continue through an intersection with a yellow light?

options.text: When an emergency vehicle is crossing your lane.
When you are already in the intersection as the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are already in the intersection as the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If the light turns yellow while you are already in the intersection, you may continue through carefully.

questions.question: What do downward-facing triangle signs mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: You must yield.
questions.explanation: Downward-facing triangle signs mean you must yield. You can proceed when the road is clear of traffic and pedestrians, and it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in residential zones?
questions.correctAnswerText: 25 mph.
questions.explanation: Unless a different speed limit is posted, the speed limit in residential, school, and business zones is 25 mph for cars and motorcycles.

questions.question: What should you do if someone is tailgating you?

options.text: Move to the right lane if one is open.
If no right lane is open, wait until the road ahead is clear and slowly reduce your speed to let them pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: If someone is tailgating you and a right lane is open, move over. If no right lane is available, wait until the road ahead is clear and slowly reduce speed to encourage them to pass. Never brake suddenly, as this increases the risk of being hit from behind.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a traffic signal ahead. Be ready for a red light, yellow light, and crossing traffic.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and other traffic.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and other traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely, check for pedestrians and crossing traffic, and wait for the intersection to clear before you go.

questions.question: When can you safely pass on a two-way, two-lane street?

options.text: Only when you can clearly see the road ahead.
Only when you can return to your lane before meeting oncoming traffic.
Only when your vehicle can go fast enough to pass.
Only when all of the above are true.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only when all of the above are true.
questions.explanation: You can only pass safely on a two-way, two-lane street when you can see the road ahead clearly, you can return to your lane before meeting oncoming traffic, and your vehicle is fast enough to pass. Never pass where it is illegal or unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after coming to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right turns are not allowed.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show rules that drivers must obey. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Two-way traffic.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What should a small vehicle driver be ready for when passing a large vehicle?

options.text: Wind gusts produced by the large vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wind gusts produced by the large vehicle.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles create strong wind gusts that can push smaller vehicles off course. When passing a large vehicle, be ready to steer carefully to stay in your lane.

questions.question: What should you do if your tire blows out?

options.text: Take your foot off the gas.
Do not immediately use your brakes.
Gradually slow down and pull off the side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: If your tire blows out, release the gas pedal first. Do not brake suddenly. Gradually slow down and gently brake as you move to the side of the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that the road curves right first, then left.

questions.question: What headlights should you use when driving in rain?
questions.correctAnswerText: Use low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: In rain, use your low beam headlights.

questions.question: ____ limit your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory.

options.text: Only a blood alcohol level greater than the legal limit can
Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
Only a blood alcohol level greater than 0.05 percent can

questions.correctAnswerText: Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
questions.explanation: Any amount of alcohol harms your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory. Even small amounts make you a worse driver. Never drink and drive.

questions.question: Which statement about railroad crossings is true?

options.text: It is against the law to go around lowered gates at a crossing.
You must stop at a railroad crossing when directed to do so by a flagger.
Not all railroad crossings are equipped with flashing red signals and gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Stop at railroad crossings when a flagger, stop sign, or warning devices tell you to. Not all crossings have lights or gates. It is illegal to drive around lowered railroad gates.

questions.question: As a pedestrian, what should you do?

options.text: Always insist on the right-of-way over a vehicle when using a crosswalk.
Never enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are approaching.
Enter a crosswalk at any time because it is the vehicle driver's responsibility to stop.
Use crosswalks only if they are convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are approaching.
questions.explanation: Do not enter a street or crosswalk if vehicles are coming. Even though pedestrians have the right-of-way in crosswalks, a vehicle moving at high speed may not be able to stop in time.

questions.question: What do work zone signs mean?

options.text: You must immediately stop and back up.
Less than ideal conditions are present for driving.
You should drive faster to get out of the work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Less than ideal conditions are present for driving.
questions.explanation: Work zone signs are orange. They tell you that construction or work is happening on or near the road. Drive carefully in these areas.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: When driving in traffic, what is safest?

options.text: Change your speed to stay alert.
Drive at the same speed as other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive at the same speed as other cars.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers go faster or slower than other vehicles. Always drive at the same speed as other traffic, but do not exceed the posted speed limit.

questions.question: If another driver cuts you off, you should:

options.text: Pull next to the driver and yell at them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let it go.
questions.explanation: Do not take it personally if another driver cuts you off. Let it go and keep driving safely. This helps avoid road rage and accidents.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver is behind you, you should:

options.text: Get out of the driver's way.
Stare at the driver as he or she passes.
Speed up as he or she tries to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get out of the driver's way.
questions.explanation: If someone is driving aggressively, move out of their way. Do not make eye contact. Speeding up may make them angrier and more dangerous.

questions.question: This sign shows:
questions.correctAnswerText: An intersection.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: A four-way intersection is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: When driving near heavy trucks, you must allow for:

options.text: The longer distance trucks need to stop.
The shorter distance trucks need to stop.
The lower noise level of trucks.

questions.correctAnswerText: The longer distance trucks need to stop.
questions.explanation: Heavy trucks need more distance to stop. Stay in areas where the truck driver can see you. Do not block their view of traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: You may drive around or under a lowering or rising gate at a railroad crossing:

options.text: If the train is not too close.
If your vehicle fits without hitting the gate.
If you look both ways first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never.
questions.explanation: When crossing gates are lowering or raising, you must stop completely. Do not cross the tracks until lights and bells stop and gates are fully up. Never drive around or under moving gates.

questions.question: Highway signs that warn about hazards are called:
questions.correctAnswerText: Warning signs.
questions.explanation: Warning signs tell you about possible dangers ahead. Obey them for your safety. Ignoring a warning sign can cause accidents.

questions.question: What do speed limit signs show?

options.text: The fastest and slowest legal speeds
The speed to drive in heavy traffic
The speed to drive in bad weather

questions.correctAnswerText: The fastest and slowest legal speeds
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs show the highest and lowest legal speeds for that road. These limits are for ideal conditions. You must slow down when conditions are poor.

questions.question: What does a double solid yellow line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers cannot pass.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Solid lines mean drivers cannot pass.

questions.question: You are driving in another driver's blind spot. What should you do?

options.text: Move ahead or drop back so the other driver can see you.
Keep driving at the same speed.
Stay in the driver's blind spot.
Honk your horn to alert them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move ahead or drop back so the other driver can see you.
questions.explanation: Never drive in another driver's blind spot. Move ahead or back so the other driver can see your vehicle.

questions.question: When turning left, who has the right-of-way over you?

options.text: Other drivers already in the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: When turning left, yield to oncoming traffic, pedestrians, bicyclists, and other drivers already in the intersection.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT part of searching while driving?

options.text: Looking ahead and behind your vehicle.
Trying to find your car in a parking lot.
Checking left, right, and left again before entering an intersection.
Looking for road clues that show hazards.

questions.correctAnswerText: Trying to find your car in a parking lot.
questions.explanation: Searching means watching the entire scene for anything in your path. This includes looking ahead and behind, checking for road hazards, and looking left-right-left before entering intersections. Finding your car in a parking lot is not part of search techniques.

questions.question: How can you help reduce road rage and aggressive driving?

options.text: Allow extra time for your trip.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: To prevent road rage, use proper turn signals, follow speed limits, and allow extra travel time. These habits reduce conflict on crowded roads.
